_meta.description: Wave 9 Batch 1 source research artifact. Per-fragrance records structured in two independent evidence tracks: (A) supplierIdentityEvidence — what the immutable raw supplier source (Fragrance_List.pdf) asserts; (B) commercialFragranceEvidence — what inspected sources (brand pages, named databases, authorised retailers, supplementary third-party databases) show about the commercial original. Fragrantica pages returned HTTP 403 and were never inspected. These tracks are kept separate because supplier text establishes WHICH product was ordered, not what the product is. rawSupplierText values are exact strings from data/supplier/raw/fragrance-list-2026-08.json.
